head_commit.message:
test(projections): isolate synthetic retry source bindings

Construct unrelated same-shard terminal work as a fresh record instead
of inheriting the original stream native proof, recovery bindings and
lease metadata. Preserve the production scheduler validation guard.

Assert the persisted real work retains its valid native proof. Protect
the fixture against the old cross-identity clone behavior and verify the
affected live convergence, health and shard scenario on isolated Dapr.
